description: Continue the conversation about an existing order — 'never end on an instrumental', 'put the announcement second instead' — producing a new version. Use this rather than creating a second order for the same purpose. Pass the playlist currently being composed against so the rewrite sees its real items. Interpret `status` exactly as for create_playlist_order. A new version does NOT reach playlists already using this order: they stay on the version they were assigned, until assign_playlist_order is called again. Returns, under refineOrderSequencer, the same status, diagnostics, sequencer and version as create_playlist_order.

message.description: The change to make, in plain language.

playlistId.description: The playlist (pl_...) being composed against on this turn, so the rewrite sees its real items. Omitted: the items of a playlist this order is assigned to; with none, it writes positional rules only.

name: refine_playlist_order

diagnostics.description: Each problem: stage, code, message, line.

status.description: READY: usable; INVALID: failed validation; MESSAGE: a question or refusal, nothing produced; PENDING: still running.

version.description: The version written, or null when nothing was produced.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
